intro: Every league document in one place — view online or download. Meetings are held at Penn Medicine Park, 650 North Prince St, Lancaster, PA 17603 (since February 2019; renamed from Clipper Magazine Stadium in 2025). All meetings start at 7 pm.
notes: No rosters required for Fall Ball, and both bat standards are allowed.

items.title: 2026 Meeting Dates
items.desc: The season meeting schedule: Fall Ball meeting, officer nominations and elections, team registration and payment due dates, proof of insurance, and the mandatory coaches meetings with rosters due.

items.title: 2026 Season Calendar
items.desc: Month-by-month calendar: start of season, opening day at Penn Medicine Park, holiday weekends with no games, end-of-season dates by section, playoff and year-end tournament weekends, and the LNP series dates.

items.title: End of Season Dates
items.desc: The last day of the regular season for each age and section. Please do not contact the league about extending the season.

items.title: Boundary Rule
items.desc: Section 6 of the league rules. Which member club a player must play for based on his school district, adjacent-club exceptions, releases, and Executive Committee approval.

items.title: Double Roster Rule
items.desc: Section 5 of the league rules. Players may not play for a competing baseball league. Defines tournament teams, violating players, and the forfeit penalty.

items.title: 2027 Age Chart
items.desc: Fall 2026 to Spring 2027 age chart. Birth year by month, from age 8 through age 14.

items.title: Spring Rules Summary, 8U & 10U
items.desc: Full spring rules for 8U and 10U Sections 1, 2 and 3 — also published as an interactive page on this site.

items.title: Spring Rules Summary, 12U & 14U
items.desc: Full spring rules for 12U and 14U Sections 1, 2 and 3 — also published as an interactive page on this site.

items.title: Field, Team & Coach Information Sheet
items.desc: One sheet per team: club and team name, level and section, home field with unavailable dates, and coach contact details. Also available as an online form on this site.

items.title: Team Information Sheet (Excel)
items.desc: Excel version of the team and field information sheet.

items.title: Roster Form
items.desc: Team roster form. Due at the April coaches meeting. Rosters lock June 1st.

items.title: Child Protection Policy Certificate
items.desc: Certificate each member organization signs confirming it has obtained the background clearances required by Pennsylvania law (23 Pa.C.S.A. § 6301 et seq.) for people having contact with minors.

items.title: COVID-19 Certificate
items.desc: Certificate confirming a member organization has obtained signed waivers from every participant and will comply with league guidelines.

items.title: Pitch Count Log
items.desc: The official log that must be at every game. Records pitches, both managers' signatures, required rest and eligibility dates. Limits: 8U = 50, 10U = 65 or 9 outs, 12U = 85, 14U = 95. Violation = forfeit, one-game suspension and a $50 fine.

items.title: Pitch Tracker Log
items.desc: The in-game pitch-by-pitch tracker with marking conventions. Alert the opposing manager 10 pitches before each threshold.

items.title: Catchers NOCSAE Chest Protector
items.desc: Reference document on the NOCSAE chest protector requirement for catchers.

items.title: Wristband Usage Memo
items.desc: NFHS memorandum confirming play-calling wristbands must be worn on the wrist, not the belt (NFHS Baseball Rule 1-5-11).

items.title: Bat Decertification
items.desc: Bat decertification reference. See also the USA Bat decertified bats list.

items.title: Fall Rules Summary
items.desc: Full fall rules for 8U, 10U Sections 1–2, 12U Sections 1–2, and 14U Sections 1–2 — also published as an interactive page on this site.

items.title: Fall Ball 2027 Information Sheet
items.desc: Fall Ball meeting details, levels of play with base and pitching distances, entry fees, insurance, season start and end, umpire fees and rescheduling.

items.title: Fall Ball 2027 Field, Team & Coach Information
items.desc: One sheet per Fall Ball team: club and team name, level and section, fees, home field with unavailable dates, and coach contacts.
